newsitem.title: GERMANY: SKW Trostberg expects 97 oper profit rise.
newsitem.headline: SKW Trostberg expects 97 oper profit rise.

text.p: German specialty chemical group SKW Trostberg AG said on Friday it expected operating profits in 1997 to rise and that sales would rise to 5.3 billion marks from 3.9 billion.

The group said sales in the first half of 1997 rose 40 percent to 2.7 billion marks. Net of the acquisition of MBT, sales were around seven percent higher and above first quarter levels, Wilhelm Samson, management board chairman, said in a speech.
"Earnings will follow sales and will be qualitatively better," Simson said on earnings growth. He was speaking at the group's annual shareholder conference in Munich.

Earnings would be slightly lower because of a payout for goodwill on MBT. The group's aim was to report a return on sales before interest and tax of around 10 percent, compared to seven percent in the previous year.
